findings.summary: Native Codable types and surplus checks are narrower than the general wire schema and backend mixed-unit math.
findings.whyNotHigher: Frozen demo observations are non-null and same-unit; native rejects unsupported mixed-unit decisions rather than computing a wrong basket.
findings.recommendation: Before native live Demo Grocer ingestion, decode nullable observation fields and share ounce-base normalization semantics.

findings.summary: Live research has per-operation timeouts and a six-candidate cap but no single aggregate deadline.
findings.whyNotHigher: Live mode is default-off, operator-gated, candidate-capped, and rate-limited.
findings.recommendation: Add a request-scoped deadline or AbortSignal before production live enablement.

findings.summary: Remote Browser DNS cannot be pinned through the current SDK, and the limiter keys on forwarded client-address metadata.
findings.whyNotHigher: Exact HTTPS URL admission, public-DNS checks, post-navigation URL validation, owned-host scope, and operator authentication bound the current demo.
findings.recommendation: Use locked owned DNS and a trusted proxy/client-address boundary in production.
